selection: First completed JSONL row of each task x lane, checked against first manifest lane entry; no outcome-based selection
limitations: Metadata, H264 stream, nonempty file, recorded-frame/step consistency and immutable-file hash check; not every frame decoded or visual judgement.
20fps playback time is not authoritative simulator elapsed time; actual per-action simulator timestamps retained.

Canonical new-job paths and actual model identity checked; no HTML pages or links have been created/audited here. No old61377 path or symlink used. Byte copying from old artifacts cannot be ruled out by path checks alone.
Only24 samples, not all4215; no final SR or collision-rate conclusion.
No teacher initial-pair re-audit, GPU, simulator reset/render, writes or task changes.

hash_encoding.row_sha256: SHA256 of exact first complete JSONL record bytes including its trailing newline, not the growing whole file.
hash_encoding.video_sha256: SHA256 of complete review.mp4 file bytes, checked twice with stable stat during the original audit.
hash_encoding.complete_sha256: SHA256 of complete.json bytes during original audit.
hash_encoding.steps_sha256: SHA256 of steps.jsonl bytes during original audit.

checks: All 24 are first complete JSONL records, additionally checked against their frozen manifest lane's first entry.
Actual ready and row checkpoint identity/step/mixed mode match the new student.
Frozen audit_media verified nonempty video, readable ffprobe video metadata, positive duration and first JPEG bytes matching the episode row's initial_rgb_sha256; no teacher initial-pair re-audit.
Every ffprobe stream is H264 768x432 with 20fps and finite positive duration.
nb_frames equals complete.frames, complete action-log row count and episode total_step; step sequence is contiguous from zero.
Recorded simulator timestamps are finite and nondecreasing; video duration equals nb_frames/20 to 1e-6.
complete.result matches the episode row for finish/status/success/following_rate/following_step/total_step/collision/policy_init_valid.
Each canonical video path equals the expected new task/shard path and contains no old61377 result root; no symlink redirect was used.
Video byte size, mtime, inode and SHA256 are unchanged across the original bounded audit.

preservation.source: Previously completed read-only audit evidence retained in agent memory.
